name: Goosehead Insurance, Inc.

corporate_actions.event: 8-K Item 4.02: FY2023-2025 audited statements and interims to Jun-2026 should no longer be relied upon (commission-cost capitalisation ASC 340-40; franchise fee presentation ASC 606); material weakness expected; Q3-26 10-Q delayed (NT 10-Q). Non-cash; preliminary impact raises operating income
CEO transition: Mark Jones Jr. (son of co-founder) succeeds Mark Miller

geography.fx_notes: US-only personal-lines franchise agency; state concentration in Texas, California, Illinois, Florida (state %s not extracted).

kpis.name: Gross debt / EBITDA (provider)
kpis.value: ~3.5x (PitchBook TTM 2Q26: debt $373m / EBITDA $106m); equity negative after 2025 recap

company_fcf.definition: not extracted; restatement pending (no cash impact expected)

acquisitions.notes: Organic franchise model, no material M&A. Debt rose $153m -> $352m in 1Q25 and equity turned negative (PitchBook) - consistent with a debt-funded special distribution/recap (INFERENCE; details not extracted).

management.ceo: Mark Miller (retiring 31-Dec-2026); successor Mark Jones Jr. from 1-Jan-2027
management.cfo: not verified (Mark Jones Jr. ceased to be CFO on promotion to President/COO, Apr-2026)
management.senior_turnover_5y: High: co-founder CEO -> Miller (2024) -> Jones Jr. (2027); CFO vacancy/turnover 2026
management.guidance_record: FY26 revenue guidance reaffirmed despite restatement (S2)

ownership.controlling_holders: Co-founders Mark & Robyn Jones control via Class B (Up-C) - % not extracted
ownership.related_party: Up-C with Tax Receivable Agreement; family succession; restatement originated from SEC comment letter

evidence: 2.12m policies; renewal royalties from franchise book (S4)
A.rationale: Recurring renewal commissions/royalties, though personal-lines client retention historically mid-80s% (not verified this pass).

evidence: Franchise model with service centre; written premium +10.6% (S4)
B.rationale: Some differentiation via choice of carriers and service centre, low switching costs for consumers.

evidence: Three CEO changes in ~3 years incl. founder's son (S5,S6)
F.rationale: Control failures and frequent leadership change.

G.rationale: Shareholder returns via leverage rather than reinvestment; not clearly value-destructive.

evidence: Founder-family control via Up-C; family CEO succession (S5)
Non-reliance on 3 years of audited accounts (S2)

I1.rationale: Personal lines most exposed to direct-to-consumer, comparative raters and AI agents (INFERENCE).

evidence: Homeowners rate cycle and cat-driven carrier capacity (S1)
Item 4.02 non-reliance FY2023-25; material weakness expected (S2)

sector_specific.organic_ex_rate_note: INFERENCE: written premium growth (10.6%) is below policy growth (14.5%), implying personal-lines premium per policy now flat-to-down as homeowners/auto rate increases fade; 2023-24 growth was boosted by double-digit personal-lines rate increases.
sector_specific.retention_pct: not disclosed in sources used (Q2-26 release: 'improving client retention', no number)

gates.notes: G2 = A per methodology (unresolved restatement): 8-K Item 4.02 on 6-Nov-2026 covering FY2023-25 and interims, expected material weakness, NT 10-Q. Mitigants: non-cash, SEC-comment driven, expected to raise operating income - re-test once restated 10-K/A and Q3 10-Q filed. G4 = B: cash statements for Q3 not available. G1 C: ~3.5x < 4.0x.

bull_points: Fast policy growth (+14.5%) and long franchise runway; renewal royalties are high-margin.
Restatement is non-cash and expected to increase operating income.
bear_points: Unresolved restatement, material weakness and late filing.
Personal lines are the most AI/direct-to-consumer-exposed distribution niche.
Family-controlled Up-C with frequent CEO turnover and negative book equity after recap.
thesis_breakers: Restated filings not completed by end-Q1 2027 or auditor qualification.
